description: One-shot mix assets in two families. MIDI (top): hits/risers/shots as instrument tracks carrying one deterministic root note (doubling the scene's first bass note, else the key root — no LLM) — pick any synth/rompler sound, shuffle Surge presets. Audio samples (bottom): sampler one-shots — hits on the downbeat, risers end-aligned to the loop boundary, shots at a chosen offset, including user-imported audio. Sounds rotate per scene for arrangement variety; a per-track lock pins the current sound so it repeats while auditioning FX presets.
